_README: Declare hatch for tools/queue_census.py. Mirrors tools/reachability_deferred.json.
An entry SUPPRESSES one alarm kind on one lane, and only while it is valid:
"reason": "why this is expected, in a sentence", "expires": "2026-08-06"}
Rules the census enforces, because a silenced gate is the failure this file
- No reason        -> REASONLESS: does not suppress, and is reported.
- No/bad expires   -> REASONLESS: an unexpiring suppression is a permanent
- Past expires     -> STALE: does not suppress, and is reported.
- Valid entry      -> suppresses, but the alarm is STILL PRINTED as
SUPPRESSED with its reason and expiry. Hidden alarms
Scope is (lane, kind). There is deliberately no wildcard.
SHIPPED EMPTY ON PURPOSE (2026-07-30). The UNDRAINED alarms currently firing on
the builder lanes are reporting the exact condition the chairman raised as a
problem ('no builds for 11 hrs'), so declaring them away would suppress the
signal this organ was built to produce. Whether a lane's drain is manual by
policy is the chairman's ruling to record here, not mine to assume.
